events.body:
## Context

`src/utils.py` (589 lines, pure Python) holds the core logic: `parse_pr_url`, `parse_repo_url`, `parse_org_url`, `calculate_review_status`, `calculate_ci_confidence` and `calculate_pr_readiness`. None of it is tested.

## What to do

1. Create `tests/test_utils.py` (unittest; `npm run test:cron` already runs `unittest discover -s tests`).
2. Cover valid/invalid PR URLs (trailing junk, non-string), reserved org names and CI-confidence edges (0/0/0 gives 50, all failed gives 0, mixed).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] At least 12 assertions across the six functions
- [ ] Runs under `npm test`

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-leaf
```
